description: Locked the one book and refused a new end.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Mentioned. He was learning the owl too well, and not on the call.
name: Arthur Meeks

description: Mentioned. He had Sam by the fire with honey.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Called from Aldermanbury, reported the boys, and asked after the king.
name: John Heminges

description: Mentioned. He was by the fire, dumb, and not told.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Wanted a house and not a rook, and was told the throat was not a jig.
name: Will Kemp

description: Answered the owl, agreed the order, and said the king is talking.
name: William Shakespeare
